hold_text: Seeking ONE manager/operator read of scripts/ml/export_exit_head.py, and saying plainly why rather than dressing it up. pr-landing-guard's TIER1_SURFACE allowlist lists scripts/ci/**, scripts/ops/**, scripts/research/** and scripts/reports/** but NOT scripts/ml/**, so it declines to certify self-landing on this path. CLAUDE.md's tier table calls tooling Tier-1 and trainer-vm-mode.md makes trainer work autonomous, so `tier: 1` is the accurate tier and the hold is about the guard's allowlist, not about the tier. The change is additive: --family defaults to the existing fam_dir.name derivation, so omitting it is byte-for-byte the previous behaviour, no published artifact moves, and no live runtime path imports this script.
